narr: Thunderstorms developed across east central Oklahoma during the early morning hours of the 17th. A very moist air mass across the region and weak wind flow aloft resulted in slow-moving thunderstorms that produced very heavy rainfall. More than four inches of rain fell across western portions of Sequoyah County in just a few hours, which resulted in flash flooding.
ev: Portions of the E 1020 Road, where it crosses Little Vian Creek, were flooded and impassable. Flood water washed away portions of the S 4550 Road.
Portions of several roads were reported flooded and closed, after locally heavy rain fell in the area.
